name: miniOrange MCP for Magento
description:
Connect Claude to your Magento or Adobe Commerce store and work with live store data through natural conversation. Built by miniOrange, miniOrange MCP for Magento gives store owners, operations teams, and support staff a governed way to query and manage their store without leaving Claude.

Ask questions and get answers straight from your store:
"Which products are low on stock in the Boston warehouse?"
"Show me orders placed in the last 24 hours that haven't shipped."
"Pull up the customer record and order history for jane@example.com."
"Which promotions are active this week and how are they performing?"
"Summarize invoices and shipments for order #100004521."

Security is built in. Users sign in with OAuth 2.0 (PKCE and dynamic client registration); no Magento credentials are ever shared with Claude. Every action runs under the connected admin's own permissions, so Claude can only see and change what that user is already allowed to see and change.

_published_faq.name: How do I add miniOrange MCP for Magento to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add miniOrange MCP for Magento to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://magento.miniorange.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the miniOrange MCP for Magento MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: miniOrange MCP for Magento provides these MCP tools: discover_abilities, execute_ability, and get_ability_info.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to miniOrange MCP for Magento?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to miniOrange MCP for Magento in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does miniOrange MCP for Magento MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: miniOrange MCP for Magento requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops miniOrange MCP for Magento?

acceptedAnswer.text: miniOrange MCP for Magento is developed by miniOrange. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
